instances.claim: This tells me that the work is continually redefined and never settles — three times, in the same abstract register.
instances.why: All three state the bare proposition 'the meaning keeps being remade' without naming a mechanism, a physical change, or a specific audience: 17 asserts an 'ongoing process of redefinition', 22 asserts value and meaning are 'continually redefined', and 23 asserts a 'gesture that unfolds continually'. Only 23 adds anything — the form claim ('is a becoming') and the participants who do the remaking — so 17 and 22 are its vocabulary rehearsed in advance; the shared roots 'ongoing / continually / continually' and 'redefinition / redefined' mark it. Keep 23.
